rationale: Statutory national contract-notice bulletin; canonical A2 spine for CZ banking/payment tenders (failed URL check treated as soft, re-verify liveness).
Distinct NIPEZ-hosted VVZ entry point; worth tracking separately as a migration hedge for the same notice corpus.
State e-procurement platform with full tender documentation, confirmed to carry card-acceptance/POS procedures.
Notice-stream view inside NEN; covered by monitoring nen.nipez.cz, though useful as its low-latency feed path.
DNS register is a NEN section; valuable data but collected under the NEN parent source.
Statutory ISVZ statistics/open-data system — the structured bulk route into the national notice corpus.
MMR methodology hub mapping the NIPEZ ecosystem; mine once for the authoritative list of publication venues.
Technical documentation of the Registr veřejných zakázek schema; read once to design collection, not a signal stream.
National open-data catalogue giving licence/provenance layer and discovery of procurement datasets.
Registr smluv exposes signed contract text and pricing for awarded banking/acquiring deals — highest commercial-detail source.
Civic aggregator with documented public API normalising contracts, tenders and ÚOHS decisions; strong accelerator and cross-check.
Regulator decision database revealing how contested banking/payment tenders were structured and which suppliers litigate.
TED carries all CZ above-threshold notices in structured eForms with CPV filtering; core cross-border layer.
Dominant certified e-tool network hosting profiles incl. ČNB; where full tender documentation actually lives.
Second major certified e-tool host; carries the state development bank's procurement profile.
Further profil zadavatele host, ICO-keyed, with a ČNB profile — useful named-buyer entry point.
Certified e-tool covering small-scale contracts — the terminal/gateway tier that never reaches VVZ or TED.
Minor certified e-tool; kept for host-inventory completeness but low expected banking/payment yield — revisit after coverage test.
Central bank as contracting authority: payment-system, cash-handling and financial IT tenders; highest-signal single CZ buyer.
State development bank procurement page; second high-signal public financial-institution buyer.
Finance Ministry profile plus joint purchasing — reveals aggregated payment/financial-service contracts before notices appear.
Annual MMR report published on portal-vz.cz already captured by c_007; useful baseline denominator only.
CPV taxonomy browser giving exact Czech labels for financial-services codes; mine once to build query filters.
Government service card for VVZ; a pointer to c_001 with little independent signal beyond host-migration detection.
Duplicate of c_013 (same TED portal, localised search URL); redundant in the registry.
TED Search API docs enable a repeatable machine-readable feed of CZ banking/payment notices.
